headline: 《怒之杀》领跑热度，本周新片仅四部
headlineEn: Rage Kill Leads Buzz; Only Four New Movies This Week
summary: 今日无新片上映，本周共4部新片。热搜由《怒之杀》领衔，《死神》《特别行动：母狮》《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》《玩具总动员5》紧随其后。
summaryEn: No new movies hit theaters today, with only four new releases this week. Rage Kill tops the trending chart, followed by Death, Special Ops: Lioness, Spider-Man: Brand New Day, and Toy Story 5.

industryHighlights.en: No new movies released in theaters today
Four new movies enter theaters this week
The Last Sunrise is coming soon

industryHighlights.text: 热搜榜由多部大片占据，头部效应明显
industryHighlights.en: Blockbusters dominate the trending chart, showing strong headliner effect
